TWRP 3.7.1_14 for the Xiaomi 14T (`degas`). The recovery lives in `vendor_boot`.

**Decryption is included but not tested.** This build has `/data` decryption (stock MiTEE KeyMint/Gatekeeper, tee-supplicant, NXP Weaver), ported from an OrangeFox tree where it is reported working. Nobody has run it on a device with this TWRP build yet. Back up your data, `metadata`, `persist` and both `vendor_boot` slots before trying. See [docs/RESEARCH.md](https://github.com/Advnirr/twrp_device_xiaomi_degas/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH.md) for details and a test checklist.

Changes since v1.0:
- FBE v2 + metadata decryption (untested).
- Rebased on twrp-14.1 (was twrp-12.1).
- Stock HyperOS `OS3.0.306.0.WNEEUXM` kernel modules built into the vendor ramdisk; the touch driver patch is redone on the 306 module. Use it on 306 firmware: on other versions the modules may not match your kernel.
- Built in GitHub Actions; no repack step.
- `/metadata` is mounted read-only, `persist` is mounted for the TEE.

Not retested after the rebase: touch, MTP, OTG, slot switching, Format Data.

Install (unlocked bootloader):
```
fastboot getvar current-slot
fastboot flash vendor_boot_<slot> twrp-3.7.1_14-Advnirr-degas-v1.1-beta-vendor_boot.img
fastboot reboot recovery
```
Checksum is in `SHA256SUMS`.

Credits:
- [sigmapro555eshkere](https://github.com/notnotshuts/ofox_device_xiaomi_degas): OrangeFox port of this tree with working decryption; the decryption stack, 306 modules and eSE/Weaver bring-up come from it.
- [Dip184](https://github.com/Dip184/android_device_xiaomi_duchamp/tree/orangefox-14.1): the MiTEE decryption method on duchamp.
